question: Can H4d1c safely reduce an exact finite signed rational witness z0=sum_i q_i[Z_i] to separate componentwise positive variational-Hodge/liftability mechanisms using only tangency of the total rational class alpha along one Hodge branch?
scope: smooth projective complex family; rational cohomology; already algebraic chosen finite signed rational central witness
first-order only; fixed irreducible local Hodge-locus branch for the total class alpha
coefficient-preserving selected component bookkeeping; no claim that a product of Hilbert/Chow branches is a global fine moduli space
test only logical sufficiency of componentwise transfer; no root initial algebraicity, higher Artin lifting, algebraization, monodromy, singular degeneration or global continuation

objects.V: tangent space of the base at s0 restricted to the chosen local chart
objects.h_i: linearized Hodge-variation condition for the component class [Z_i], with values embedded in a common linear Hodge-obstruction target Q
objects.h_alpha: sum_i q_i h_i, the linearized Hodge condition for alpha=sum_i q_i[Z_i]

candidate_transfer: From h_alpha(v)=0 infer h_i(v)=0 for every selected component, then apply source-specific componentwise witness-liftability mechanisms and intersect their reachable base directions.
precommitted_falsifier: Exhibit a finite-dimensional linear interface satisfying h_alpha(v)=0 for a nonzero v while some h_i(v) is nonzero. Such an interface refutes the transfer from total-class tangency to componentwise Hodge persistence unless an additional no-cancellation/joint-detection hypothesis is present.
positive_controls: codimension-one Picard/Lefschetz-(1,1), where denominator-cleared total divisor data can be represented by a single line-bundle class rather than requiring componentwise Hodge persistence
Kloosterman complete-intersection hypersurface theorem, where source-specific flag-Hilbert geometry directly compares the Hodge locus to an actual witness locus for the chosen cycle
transfer_disanalogies: higher-codimension rational signed witnesses generally lack Picard-style single-object representability
total-class Hodge tangency is linear in cohomology and can cancel across selected component contributions
componentwise positive theorems have hypotheses on each component class, not merely on their weighted sum
first-order no-cancellation would still leave higher-order and gluing obligations open
